title: Missale iuxta ritum Ecclesiae Apostolicae Antiochenae Syrorum (Sharfeh Patriarchal, 1922) — Anaphora of St. James Core — complete constituent extent and page account
scope: Bounded constituent of the exact same six aligned core units of the Anaphora of St. James (Preface, Sanctus, Post-Sanctus, Institution Narrative, Anamnesis, and Epiclesis) in Classical Syriac (syr), enabling a direct 1843 vs 1922 Syriac Catholic visual diff; reads right-hand Syriac column on bilingual pages (PDF 246, 245) and full-width Syriac on monolingual pages (PDF 245 bottom, 244 L1, 241, 240, 239), excluding Dialogue, parallel Garshuni, red rubrics, blank page PDF 243, and Crucifixion engraving plate PDF 242.

pages.description: Latin front matter/decree/dissertation (PDF 1-20), native contents (PDF 22-23), post-epiclesis diptychs, remaining six anaphoras, and propers.
Full-width Anamnesis and opening of Epiclesis (printed p. 70 / ܥ).
Full-width Institution Narrative of Bread and Chalice (printed p. 69 / ܣܛ).
Full-page Crucifixion engraving plate preceding Institution Narrative.
Blank verso of Crucifixion engraving plate.
Final line of Post-Sanctus (printed p. 68 / ܣܚ; pre-institution rubrics below excluded).
Conclusion of Preface (right Syriac col.), four-word Sanctus incipit, and body of Post-Sanctus (printed p. 67 / ܣܙ).
Opening of Preface (full-width top and right-hand Syriac column; printed p. 66 / ܣܘ; Dialogue above excluded to match 1843 bounds).
Pre-anaphoral Ordo Communis, Presanctified, and Syriac title (PDF 339).
